name: com.dyvoid.feathertween
description: A robust, minimal C# tween engine for Unity. Compositional sequences, static-method API, struct handles, PlayerLoop runner.

samples.description: A demo MonoBehaviour that spawns primitives showcasing move, scale, rotate, color, and bounce tweens.
A choreographed show exercising sequence features: Append/Join, SetDefaults cascade, callbacks, AddPause with auto-resume, label-based Insert, deferred From snap, and Restart looping.

A small preview of the phase 1.17 showcase: one master sequence with four captioned chapters (ease race, loops, deferred From drop, synchronized finale) driven by a player panel — seek bar, play/pause, reverse, speed, and chapter jumps all operate on the root sequence.

The M1 acceptance demo: infinite Incremental/Yoyo loops, EveryLoop-staggered generic tweens with parametric elastic ease, a master sequence with a nested sub-sequence and label-based deferred From, plus a runtime control panel (pause/resume all, reverse, seek, global time scale, target-filtered kill).
